description: Mã chỉ số (rổ) mà mã chứng khoán thuộc về trong ngày; chuỗi rỗng ('') = dòng 'không theo rổ' dùng cho truy vấn không chọn chiều Chỉ số. Mã CK thuộc N rổ thì có N dòng + 1 dòng rỗng — truy vấn KHÔNG chọn Chỉ số phải lọc index_code = '' để không đếm trùng.

description: Loại chứng khoán hiển thị (nhãn tiếng Việt, VD Cổ phiếu / Trái phiếu / Chứng chỉ quỹ), dẫn xuất theo mã sàn và mã loại chứng khoán — chiều Phân loại mã chứng khoán của Data Explorer.

source_attribute: Floor Code / Stock Type Code / Fund Type Code

description: Mã ngành cấp 1 của doanh nghiệp phát hành mã chứng khoán (chiều Ngành). Công ty chứng khoán đại chúng không có ngành trong IDS thì dùng ngành '07000' (O_GSTT_37).
etl_logic: [Driving security_trading_snapshot = bản tin cuối ngày: rn PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC, security_trading_snapshot.sequence DESC; WHERE rn = 1] LEFT JOIN public_company ON ((security_trading_snapshot.stock_tp_code = '1' AND NOT (UPPER(security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol) LIKE '__GB%' OR SUBSTR(UPPER(security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol),3,2) = 'GB' OR SUBSTR(UPPER(security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol),1,2) IN ('TD','TP','CP','QH','KB','BL') OR UPPER(security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol) LIKE 'HCM%' OR UPPER(security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol) LIKE 'HAN%') AND public_company.equity_ticker_symbol = SUBSTR(security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol,1,3)) OR (security_trading_snapshot.stock_tp_code <> '1' AND public_company.equity_ticker_symbol = (CASE WHEN security_trading_snapshot.floor_code IN ('02','04','10') AND security_trading_snapshot.stock_tp_code = '4' THEN security_trading_snapshot.underlying_symbol ELSE security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol END))) LEFT JOIN securities_company ON UPPER(TRIM(securities_company.securities_code)) = UPPER(TRIM(security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol)) AND securities_company.pc_ind = 1 AND (securities_company.provisional_ind = 0 OR securities_company.provisional_ind IS NULL) LEFT JOIN cl_business_line fallback_business_line ON fallback_business_line.cl_business_line_code = '07000' AND fallback_business_line.active_ind = 1 AND fallback_business_line.src_stm_code = 'ECAT_BUSINESS_LINE_LEVEL_1' → COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(public_company.business_line_level_1_code), ''), CASE WHEN securities_company.sc_code IS NOT NULL THEN fallback_business_line.cl_business_line_code END)
source_entity: Public Company / Securities Company / Classification Business Line
source_attribute: Business Line Level 1 Code / Securities Company Code / Classification Business Line Code

description: Lợi nhuận sau thuế 4 quý gần nhất (TTM) của doanh nghiệp phát hành theo báo cáo tài chính đã duyệt — dùng tính EPS, P/E.
etl_logic: [Driving security_trading_snapshot = bản tin cuối ngày: rn PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC, security_trading_snapshot.sequence DESC; WHERE rn = 1] INNER JOIN public_company ON public_company.equity_ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' → LEFT JOIN pc_report_submission ON pc_report_submission.pc_id = public_company.pc_id AND pc_report_submission.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) IN ('HN','TH','ME','RI') AND pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter IN (1,2,3,4) AND pc_report_submission.submission_dt <= security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt [rn0 PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_id, pc_report_submission.rpt_year, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter ORDER BY CASE SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) WHEN 'HN' THEN 1 WHEN 'TH' THEN 2 WHEN 'ME' THEN 3 WHEN 'RI' THEN 4 END, pc_report_submission.submission_dt DESC — chốt ĐÚNG 1 báo cáo/kỳ trước khi xếp hạng kỳ, tránh gộp nhầm nhiều mẫu biểu cùng kỳ thành nhiều kỳ khác nhau] WHERE rn0 = 1 [rn1 PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_id ORDER BY pc_report_submission.rpt_year DESC, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter DESC — tối đa 4 kỳ QUÝ (1-4) gần nhất đã công bố tính đến ngày giao dịch — mỗi kỳ đã chốt đúng 1 báo cáo ở bước rn0, tránh gộp nhầm nhiều mẫu biểu cùng kỳ thành 4 "kỳ" giả] WHERE rn1 <= 4 → INNER JOIN fr_value ON fr_value.pc_id = pc_report_submission.pc_id AND fr_value.rpt_year = pc_report_submission.rpt_year AND fr_value.rpt_quarter = pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter → INNER JOIN fr_catalog ON fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id = fr_value.fr_catalog_id AND fr_catalog.financial_statement_tp_code = SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) AND fr_catalog.rpt_code LIKE 'BCKQKD%' → INNER JOIN fr_row_template ON fr_row_template.row_code = fr_value.row_code AND fr_row_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND ((fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code IN ('DN','BH') AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '60') OR (fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code = 'TD' AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '21')) → INNER JOIN fr_column_template ON fr_column_template.column_code = fr_value.column_code AND fr_column_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND fr_column_template.column_description_reference = '1' → CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(fr_value.cell_val) END

description: Lợi nhuận sau thuế 4 quý gần nhất (TTM) của công ty chứng khoán đại chúng theo báo cáo nghiệp vụ — dự phòng cho P/E khi mã không có báo cáo tài chính.
etl_logic: [Driving security_trading_snapshot = bản tin cuối ngày: rn PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC, security_trading_snapshot.sequence DESC; WHERE rn = 1] INNER JOIN securities_company ON UPPER(TRIM(securities_company.securities_code)) = UPPER(TRIM(security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol)) AND securities_company.pc_ind = 1 AND (securities_company.provisional_ind = 0 OR securities_company.provisional_ind IS NULL) → INNER JOIN sc_periodic_report ON sc_periodic_report.sc_id = securities_company.sc_id AND sc_periodic_report.src_stm_code = 'SCMS_SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT' AND sc_periodic_report.rpt_period = 'QUY' AND sc_periodic_report.rpt_submission_status_code IN ('1','2') AND sc_periodic_report.end_dt <= security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt → INNER JOIN sc_report_input_submission ON sc_report_input_submission.ref_id = sc_periodic_report.sc_periodic_rpt_id AND sc_report_input_submission.ref_tp_code IS NOT NULL AND sc_report_input_submission.src_stm_code = 'SCMS_REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION' → INNER JOIN sc_report ON sc_report.sc_rpt_id = sc_report_input_submission.sc_rpt_id AND sc_report.rpt_tp_code = 'INPUT' AND sc_report.rpt_code IN ('BCTCHN','BCTCRL') [rn_sub PARTITION BY sc_report_input_submission.ref_tp_code, sc_report_input_submission.ref_id, sc_report.rpt_code ORDER BY sc_report_input_submission.sc_rpt_input_submission_id DESC — chỉ lấy bản nộp mới nhất của mỗi báo cáo kỳ] WHERE rn_sub = 1 [rn0 PARTITION BY sc_periodic_report.sc_id, sc_periodic_report.rpt_year, sc_periodic_report.period ORDER BY CASE sc_report.rpt_code WHEN 'BCTCHN' THEN 1 description: P/E của rổ chỉ số = tổng vốn hóa các mã thành viên / tổng LNST TTM, làm tròn 2 chữ số. Lặp lại trên mỗi mã CK của rổ — gộp bằng MAX theo chỉ số + ngày, không SUM; NULL ở dòng 'không theo rổ'.
etl_logic: [Driving security_trading_snapshot = bản tin cuối ngày: rn PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC, security_trading_snapshot.sequence DESC; WHERE rn = 1] LEFT JOIN index_constituent_snapshot ON index_constituent_snapshot.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol AND index_constituent_snapshot.trading_dt = security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt → LEFT JOIN (SELECT ics2.index_code, ics2.trading_dt, ROUND(SUM(std2.close_price * lsi.outstanding_share_quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(lnst.lnst_ttm, sc_lnst.lnst_ttm)), 0), 2) AS agg_val FROM index_constituent_snapshot ics2 INNER JOIN security_trading_snapshot std2 ON std2.ticker_symbol = ics2.ticker_symbol AND std2.trading_dt = ics2.trading_dt [rn PARTITION BY std2.ticker_symbol, std2.trading_dt ORDER BY std2.trading_time DESC, std2.sequence DESC] AND rn = 1 LEFT JOIN listed_share_information lsi ON lsi.ticker_symbol = ics2.ticker_symbol AND lsi.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND lsi.ds_snpst_dt = (SELECT MAX(sc2.ds_snpst_dt) FROM listed_share_information sc2 WHERE sc2.ticker_symbol = ics2.ticker_symbol AND sc2.src_stm_code = 'VSDC_OUTSTANDING_SHARES' AND sc2.ds_snpst_dt <= ics2.trading_dt) LEFT JOIN (SELECT public_company.equity_ticker_symbol AS symbol, ics3.trading_dt, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(fr_value.cell_val) END AS lnst_ttm FROM index_constituent_snapshot ics3 INNER JOIN public_company ON public_company.equity_ticker_symbol = ics3.ticker_symbol AND public_company.src_stm_code = 'IDS_COMPANY_PROFILES' LEFT JOIN pc_report_submission ON pc_report_submission.pc_id = public_company.pc_id AND pc_report_submission.approval_status_code = 'APPROVED' AND SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) IN ('HN','TH','ME','RI') AND pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter IN (1,2,3,4) AND pc_report_submission.submission_dt <= ics3.trading_dt [rn0 PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_id, pc_report_submission.rpt_year, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter ORDER BY CASE SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) WHEN 'HN' THEN 1 WHEN 'TH' THEN 2 WHEN 'ME' THEN 3 WHEN 'RI' THEN 4 END, pc_report_submission.submission_dt DESC] WHERE rn0 = 1 [rn1 PARTITION BY pc_report_submission.pc_id ORDER BY pc_report_submission.rpt_year DESC, pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter DESC] WHERE rn1 <= 4 INNER JOIN fr_value ON fr_value.pc_id = pc_report_submission.pc_id AND fr_value.rpt_year = pc_report_submission.rpt_year AND fr_value.rpt_quarter = pc_report_submission.rpt_quarter INNER JOIN fr_catalog ON fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id = fr_value.fr_catalog_id AND fr_catalog.financial_statement_tp_code = SUBSTR(pc_report_submission.fr_code,1,2) AND fr_catalog.rpt_code LIKE 'BCKQKD%' INNER JOIN fr_row_template ON fr_row_template.row_code = fr_value.row_code AND fr_row_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND ((fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code IN ('DN','BH') AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '60') OR (fr_catalog.enterprise_tp_code = 'TD' AND fr_row_template.row_description_reference = '21')) INNER JOIN fr_column_template ON fr_column_template.column_code = fr_value.column_code AND fr_column_template.fr_catalog_id = fr_catalog.fr_catalog_id AND fr_column_template.column_description_reference = '1' GROUP BY public_company.equity_ticker_symbol, ics3.trading_dt) lnst ON lnst.symbol = ics2.ticker_symbol AND lnst.trading_dt = ics2.trading_dt LEFT JOIN (SELECT securities_company.securities_code AS symbol, ics4.trading_dt, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 4 THEN SUM(TRY_CAST(sc_report_input_value.cell_val AS DECIMAL(23,2))) END AS lnst_ttm FROM index_constituent_snapshot ics4 INNER JOIN securities_company ON UPPER(TRIM(securities_company.securities_code)) = UPPER(TRIM(ics4.ticker_symbol)) AND securities_company.pc_ind = 1 AND (securities_company.provisional_ind = 0 OR securities_company.provisional_ind IS NULL) INNER JOIN sc_periodic_report ON sc_periodic_report.sc_id = securities_company.sc_id AND sc_periodic_report.src_stm_code = 'SCMS_SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT' AND sc_periodic_report.rpt_period = 'QUY' AND sc_periodic_report.rpt_submission_status_code IN ('1','2') AND sc_periodic_report.end_dt <= ics4.trading_dt INNER JOIN sc_report_input_submission ON sc_report_input_submission.ref_id = sc_periodic_report.sc_periodic_rpt_id AND sc_report_input_submission.ref_tp_code IS NOT NULL AND sc_report_input_submission.src_stm_code = 'SCMS_REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION' INNER JOIN sc_report ON sc_report.sc_rpt_id = sc_report_input_submission.sc_rpt_id AND sc_report.rpt_tp_code = 'INPUT' AND sc_report.rpt_code IN ('BCTCHN','BCTCRL') [rn_sub PARTITION BY sc_report_input_submission.ref_tp_code, sc_report_input_submission.ref_id, sc_report.rpt_code ORDER BY sc_report_input_submission.sc_rpt_input_submission_id DESC — chỉ lấy bản nộp mới nhất của mỗi báo cáo kỳ] WHERE rn_sub = 1 [rn0 PARTITION BY sc_periodic_report.sc_id, sc_periodic_report.rpt_year, sc_periodic_report.period ORDER BY CASE sc_report.rpt_code WHEN 'BCTCHN' THEN 1 WHEN 'BCTCRL' THEN 2 END — chốt ĐÚNG 1 báo cáo/kỳ: hợp nhất BCTCHN ưu tiên, riêng lẻ BCTCRL chỉ khi CTCK không nộp BCTCHN cùng kỳ] WHERE rn0 = 1 [rn1 PARTITION BY sc_periodic_report.sc_id ORDER BY sc_periodic_report.rpt_year DESC, sc_periodic_report.period DESC — tối đa 4 kỳ QUÝ gần nhất đã có báo cáo tính đến ngày giao dịch] WHERE rn1 <= 4 INNER JOIN sc_report_input_value ON sc_report_input_value.sc_rpt_input_submission_id = sc_report_input_submission.sc_rpt_input_submission_id AND sc_report_input_value.src_stm_code = 'SCMS_REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE' AND TRY_CAST(sc_report_input_value.cell_val AS DECIMAL(23,2)) IS NOT NULL AND ((sc_report.rpt_code = 'BCTCHN' AND sc_report_input_value.cell_id = 'TS121') OR (sc_report.rpt_code = 'BCTCRL' AND sc_report_input_value.cell_id = 'TS119')) GROUP BY securities_company.securities_code, ics4.trading_dt) sc_lnst ON sc_lnst.symbol = ics2.ticker_symbol AND sc_lnst.trading_dt = ics2.trading_dt WHERE ics2.trading_dt = :etl_date GROUP BY ics2.index_code, ics2.trading_dt) idx_agg ON idx_agg.index_code = index_constituent_snapshot.index_code AND idx_agg.trading_dt = index_constituent_snapshot.trading_dt → idx_agg.agg_val

description: Tên chuẩn của chỉ số (rổ) — VN-Index/HNX-Index/UPCoM-Index/VN30... — dùng hiển thị chiều Chỉ số của Data Explorer. Lấy từ Market Index Snapshot qua đẳng thức Market Code = Index Code (không join theo tên). Cấp chỉ số × ngày — lặp lại trên mỗi mã CK của rổ; NULL ở dòng 'không theo rổ' (index_code = '') hoặc khi Market Index Snapshot không có market_code tương ứng trong ngày.
etl_logic: [Driving security_trading_snapshot = bản tin cuối ngày: rn PARTITION BY security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol, security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY security_trading_snapshot.trading_time DESC, security_trading_snapshot.sequence DESC; WHERE rn = 1] LEFT JOIN index_constituent_snapshot ON index_constituent_snapshot.ticker_symbol = security_trading_snapshot.ticker_symbol AND index_constituent_snapshot.trading_dt = security_trading_snapshot.trading_dt → LEFT JOIN (SELECT market_index_snapshot.market_code, market_index_snapshot.trading_dt, market_index_snapshot.index_nm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY market_index_snapshot.market_code, market_index_snapshot.trading_dt ORDER BY market_index_snapshot.index_time DESC, market_index_snapshot.sequence DESC) AS rn FROM market_index_snapshot WHERE market_index_snapshot.src_stm_code = 'MDDS_JAD_MARKETINFOR' AND market_index_snapshot.trading_dt = :etl_date) market_index_snapshot_last ON market_index_snapshot_last.market_code = index_constituent_snapshot.index_code AND market_index_snapshot_last.trading_dt = index_constituent_snapshot.trading_dt AND market_index_snapshot_last.rn = 1 → market_index_snapshot_last.index_nm
